scope: Shared construction guidance for every catalog entry; not a rendering engine or export certification

shared_rules.identity: User choices and evidenced identity take precedence over catalog suggestions. Faithful reproduction preserves the original system.
shared_rules.typography: Resolve display, body and label roles for every style. Verify actual fonts and reflow after substitution. Pairing examples are optional, not an allowlist.
shared_rules.images: Choose full-bleed, crop, split, band or no-image composition by meaning. Protect reading regions and preserve actual subject detail.
shared_rules.effects: Outlined text, gradients, tags, layering and organic composition are available to any style when appropriate and supported; they are not mandatory.
shared_rules.evidence: Requested charts, tables and semantic diagrams remain editable when supported. Preserve source data, units, topology and proportional geometry; record an explicit alternative when unsupported.
shared_rules.rhythm: Compose the requested narrative and count; vary geometry when it improves meaning. A template is not limited to its cover preview or a fixed demo sequence.
shared_rules.review: Render every final slide and overview; inspect fonts, fit, contrast, crops and native evidence. Structural coverage does not certify visual quality.

analytical.label: IBM Plex Mono
analytical.composition: Evidence-led hierarchy; align comparisons and distinguish decisions from supporting detail.
analytical.image_role: Context or conceptual anchor when useful; preserve a quiet data surface.
analytical.chapter_closing: Use the actual decision, question or synthesis as the pause and ending.

technical.label: IBM Plex Mono
technical.composition: Precise hierarchy and relationships; derive atmosphere and density from the actual source rather than a generic technology aesthetic.
technical.image_role: Object, setting, observation or material that explains the subject.
technical.chapter_closing: A clear change of state, system boundary or next test can set the rhythm.

editorial.label: DM Sans
editorial.composition: Headline, reading column and image counterweight; use the actual story to choose asymmetric or quiet regions.
editorial.image_role: Narrative photograph, detail or full spread with real negative space.
editorial.chapter_closing: Create a chapter spread and a specific editorial conclusion rather than an obligatory corporate CTA.

photographic.label: DM Sans
photographic.composition: Let the image establish the anchor; derive type character from the source and subject, not photography alone.
photographic.image_role: Full-bleed, split crop, band or image window according to subject and reading space.
photographic.chapter_closing: Use a change of crop, type scale or quiet surface to separate narrative moments.

organic.label: DM Sans
organic.composition: Content-led cadence, material and asymmetry; maintain precise evidence and logo geometry.
organic.image_role: Natural edge, human gesture, texture or space when evidenced or intentionally inferred.
organic.chapter_closing: Use open space or material contrast; organic does not require blobs or rounded cards.

minimal.label: DM Sans
minimal.composition: Economy of elements and strong optical hierarchy; choose serif or sans according to source character.
minimal.image_role: One meaningful image or deliberate absence; avoid empty decoration.
minimal.chapter_closing: A change of scale, position or field can provide contrast without adding clutter.

experimental.label: IBM Plex Mono
experimental.composition: Derive one expressive gesture from the particular source; a family is not a single look. Keep reading and evidence stable.
experimental.image_role: Relevant artwork, physical material, photographic atmosphere or typography-led absence.
experimental.chapter_closing: Vary visual mass and density deliberately; static effects do not certify animation.

institutional.label: DM Sans
institutional.composition: Preserve evidenced identity and hierarchy; support teaching, policy or institutional narrative without borrowing another institution's identity.
institutional.image_role: Approved institutional assets or explicitly conceptual imagery, with protected reading regions.
institutional.chapter_closing: Mark real topic transitions and end with the relevant learning, decision or action.

custom.label: DM Sans
custom.composition: A custom entry has no predetermined identity. Derive a system from the user's reference or record a provisional inferred direction.
custom.image_role: Determine from the supplied identity and content; do not invent official assets.
custom.chapter_closing: Derive topic covers and closing behavior after the custom visual direction is established.
